cards.speaker: Owen
cards.text: Sorry, could we try a second kind of calc? Right now we lean on one or two. A new ore type, healthy and working, gives Archie another thing to sell and James another thing to craft.

cards.speaker: Owen
cards.text: I'm sorry if this is too much. I'd like us to get a different kind of calc online. I've only worked the ones we have, so I'd learn it as I go. Another ore means more to sell, more to craft, and less hanging on one price.

cards.speaker: Owen
cards.text: If it's all right, I'd like to bring a vein of a different type online. I haven't done it before, so I'm sorry if it's slow. Two kinds of calc at once is more choice for Archie's buyers and James's benches.

cards.speaker: Owen
cards.text: Sorry, I know it's a lot. Could we add another ore type? It has to be healthy enough to work before it counts. I'd like the practice, and it gives the others a second calc to sell and make things with.
